acceptance_criteria: cargo check -p jmap-mail-server --features sieve passes; MemoryBackend implements SieveBackend; all sieve methods have working stub implementations
design:
Location: tests/memory_backend.rs (or a new tests/sieve_backend.rs alongside the existing MemoryMailBackend).

Storage: Arc<Mutex<SieveStore>> where SieveStore holds:
  - scripts: HashMap<Id, SieveScript>
  - state: String (incremented on any mutation)
  - blobs: HashMap<Id, Vec<u8>> (shared with MemoryMailBackend or separate — reuse existing blob store)

get_sieve_scripts: filter by ids, return list + notFound.

set_sieve_scripts:
  - create: generate Id, check name uniqueness (alreadyExists), check maxNumberScripts, check maxSizeScript (blob size), run sieve validation (see below). Insert. Apply on_success_deactivate/activate after all mutations.
  - update: apply patch, re-validate if blobId changed, re-check name uniqueness.
  - destroy: reject if isActive == true (sieveIsActive), remove.
  - Activation state machine: at most one script has isActive == true at any time.

validate_sieve_script: for MemorySieveBackend, use a minimal Sieve validator:
  - Accept any non-empty UTF-8 blob that starts with require or does not start with a clearly invalid token.
  - Alternatively, always return valid (null error) for test purposes, unless the blob content is exactly the test constant INVALID_SIEVE_CONTENT. Document this limitation clearly.

query_sieve_scripts: filter on name substring and/or isActive; sort by name or isActive; apply position/limit/anchor.

VacationResponse compatibility: if a script has id matching a reserved VR id, reject content update and destroy with forbidden SetError.

Spec ref: draft-ietf-jmap-sieve-22 §2.3.1, §2.4.1 for test fixture data.
title: sieve: MemorySieveBackend for tests
